name: Hyundai Engineering & Construction
description: Korean plant and construction EPC: refinery packages (Al-Zour refinery in Kuwait with other Korean contractors), Middle East oil and gas mega-projects, and power diversification - reported October 2025 as the first Korean EPC firm to win a US nuclear power plant contract. Legally distinct from Hyundai Engineering Co., Ltd.
